code='''def transform(g):
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    seen = set()
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if not g[y][x] or (y, x) in seen:
                continue
            stack, comp = [(y, x)], []
            seen.add((y, x))
            while stack:
                a, b = stack.pop()
                comp.append((a, b))
                for q in ((a-1,b), (a+1,b), (a,b-1), (a,b+1)):
                    if 0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w and g[q[0]][q[1]] and q not in seen:
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            y0, y1 = min(a for a,b in comp), max(a for a,b in comp)
            x0, x1 = min(b for a,b in comp), max(b for a,b in comp)
            colors = sorted(set(g[a][b] for a,b in comp), key=lambda c: min(min(a-y0,y1-a,b-x0,x1-b) for a,b in comp if g[a][b] == c))
            mapping = {c: colors[-1-i] for i,c in enumerate(colors)}
            for a,b in comp:
                out[a][b] = mapping[g[a][b]]
    return out
'''
